verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle inside its cream circle, the pill buttons and a clean left-aligned headline. However, everything is packed into the top 60% of the canvas, leaving a large empty orange area at the bottom. The NEW/Try It stack is pushed right, away from the headline's left edge, and the decorative circle is cropped awkwardly in the corner. B has lost the bottle's cream circle, which is now a stray blob colliding with the 'Blood'/'Sunset' headline on the left edge. The headline nearly runs edge to edge, the buttons have lost their pill shape (square corners), and the centred NEW chip and right-hugging Try It button don't share an axis.
